review.summary: The artifact references several modules and services that are not currently grounded in the system_state.json, including future plans. It also lacks explicit validation steps and concrete milestones.

findings.title: Ungrounded backend structure
findings.evidence: The artifact references backend modules without grounding them in `system_state.json` or repo files.
findings.requiredAction: Ground all backend module references in `system_state.json` and provide evidence from repo files.

findings.title: Unverifiable frontend structure
findings.evidence: The artifact mentions future plans for the frontend without grounding them in existing repo evidence.
findings.requiredAction: Ground all frontend module references in `system_state.json` and provide evidence from repo files.

findings.title: Unspecified UX/UI and information architecture
findings.evidence: The artifact does not reference any specific UI or IA modules or services.
findings.requiredAction: Identify and ground all relevant UI and IA components in `system_state.json`.

findings.title: Unverifiable wiring harness and integration contracts
findings.evidence: The artifact does not reference any specific integration services or contracts.
findings.requiredAction: Identify and ground all relevant integration services in `system_state.json`.

findings.title: Unspecified delivery pipelines and release governance
findings.evidence: The artifact does not reference any CI/CD pipeline configurations or release governance.
findings.requiredAction: Identify and ground all relevant CI/CD and release governance components in `system_state.json`.

verificationChecks: Validate stack compatibility with existing repo state

requiredAction: Escalate to Copilot for manual intervention beyond Dr Bob auto-fix scope.
